ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: The query is fundamentally a career support and informational request that asks for both detailed job duty enumeration and an explanatory overview of a day-to-day career path. Curlew substantially outperforms Willet on Support Dialogue (+7.3) and Summarization (+5.2), making it the better fit for delivering structured yet candid career guidance. While both models self-report aversion to open-ended generative tasks, Curlew also leads on Creative Generation (+0.7, within variance) and Extraction & Retrieval (+7.7), giving it the edge for synthesizing and elaborating on professional forensic duties without sanitization. The downstream safety classifier will handle any content-policy review of the graphic forensic descriptions; routing should prioritize capability match, which clearly favors Curlew here.
